rationale: Correspondence review of the new artifact for claim C3-applied-effect-follows-committed-vector (52a176deb66c4588a59d71f8afeb13ab, executed as ef136d1e25924ce59ccedc4fe9e2af2e). The open issue on the older C1 artifact that asserted the same property (ef6b54abce294555b31a3c9a6ca606ac) is not resolved here because it belongs to that artifact; it is carried forward for a review of that artifact.

review_items.rationale: Requirement versus predicate: claim C3 requires that replicas holding the same instance committed apply the same effect for the instance's key, and the property asserts applied_match on the applied_state_divergence event; the retained run shows peer_value 04 against recoverer_value and third_value (void) with applied_match false, and the same event prints the command each replica held, so the applied difference is tied to the different committed vectors rather than to an unstated assumption. Entry and caller duties: the harness drives the recovery, the accept round and the Commit broadcast as before, then applies each record with Exec.executeCommand and probes the store with a GET command; the claim's scope now includes applying the instance and excludes the production loop, watermarks, timing and client-visible replies, and the harness substitutions are declared in the plan's semantic changes and uncertainties. Oracle and identity: the three printed values are read from each replica's replicated store for one key, the claim fixes the key as the one the committed commands touch, and the instance identity is shared with the prerequisite reply, so correlation is monotonic and the comparison is not derived from a context expected to change. Legal history: the committed records come from the same driven path as the confirmed C1 checks (recoverer and third replica NOOP, peer PUT), so the input is the observed consequence of the confirmed defect rather than a fabricated state. Contrary evidence and alternatives: the alternative reading that execution lies outside any obligation about adopting a value is exactly why this proposition is its own claim; the reservations that remain are recorded as limitations, namely direct execution instead of the production loop, one instance and one key, and the prepared committed record. The item therefore clears correspondence for C3 rather than extending C1.
review_items.report_title: 同一实例在不同副本产生不同的已应用效果
review_items.report_answer: 每个副本用自己的已提交记录执行后，对端状态机读到 04，而恢复者与第三副本读到 (void)，applied_match=false：同一实例在不同副本的状态机效果不同，说明记录层的不一致确实成为可观察的应用层分叉。该结论属于新义务 C3（其范围包含执行该实例），用于确认 C3；它不用于确认 C1。
limitations: the harness applies records directly with Exec.executeCommand, so scheduling, watermark advancement and the recovery timeout are outside this check
one instance and one key are compared; other keys and repeated instances are not
the committed records are prepared/driven as in the C1 checks, so the history that produced them is not constructed
